title: skills: data-hooks.md still teaches the deprecated handler first and an unguarded hook condition; formula SKILL has an unguarded example
body:
domain:skills#3 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAj7CvjkGXvgXzd6RZ7

Filing gate: the out-of-claim sites the #31113 card thread reported and the contract review of PR #31127 (comment 6707646253, S2 and § other sites) confirmed. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane.
class: c (metadata an AI writes from the skill is refused at publish, or uses a deprecated door) · reach: every agent reading the published `objectstack-data` and `objectstack-formula` skills.

## What is wrong (on `main` `5f003744`; PR #31127 fixed the same errors elsewhere)

1. **`skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` teaches `handler` first.** Inline `handler` sites at L97, L161, L170 (string ref) above § Sandboxed Hook Bodies (L309), and L739, L817, L845, L890 (string ref) below it; the comparison table at L319. The same file marks `handler` deprecated (`HookSchema`: prefer `body`). After PR #31127 the skill index and examples teach `body`; the reference should too, with `handler` only as the deprecated form.
2. **data-hooks.md L219**: the hook `condition` `record.annual_revenue > 1000000` compares a declared-nullable field bare. Hook conditions are a surface of the publish-time null-guard rule (`validate-null-guards.ts`). Guard it as `objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` teaches.
3. **data-hooks.md § Capabilities** names "Connector recipes" as the route for outbound calls but links nowhere. Link `skills/objectstack-automation/references/integration-recipes.md` (a `record-before-*` flow with `connector_action`); PR #31127's validation.md now points here for external-API checks.
4. **`skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` L268**: `record.amount > 10000` is unguarded inside an `os:check` block, against the same skill's own rule (L112–L122).

## Owed

One text-only PR: `body` taught first across data-hooks.md (rewrite each example after reading what `body` receives and which capabilities it needs; a body has no outbound HTTP), the two guards, the link. Correct or add an eval case per site. Both files are token-ratcheted: pay by same-file deletion or the standing ruling.

**Level:** `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Related: #31113, PR #31127.
